name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any public website for AI discoverability (getting found/cited by AI assistants) and on-site engagement (keeping the visitor once they arrive), then reports evidence-backed, severity-ranked, prioritized findings and fixes, plus a published-research-grounded proactive content strategy (Aggarwal et al., GEO: Generative Engine Optimization, KDD'24). Read-only throughout.
